(JSON has no comments of its own, so this one is a member the loader
Each entry under mcpServers is one server. Its name may hold letters,
digits, '_' and '-' only, and it becomes part of every tool name the model
sees: a tool called 'read_file' on the server 'filesystem' is offered as
command  start this program and speak MCP over its standard streams
args     the arguments for that program
env      variables added to the server's copy of the environment
url      a Streamable HTTP endpoint, instead of a command
headers  sent with every HTTP request; where a token goes
timeoutMs  how long a request waits for an answer, default 60000.
Subprocess servers only: std.http has no read timeout, so an
HTTP server that never answers holds the agent
disabled   keep this entry, but do not start it
